data_lat_chosen_threads.what: threads of the chosen setting of the decision server

data_lat_fit_requests.what: public confirmation requests the linear fit is applied to

data_lat_fit_median.what: estimated median seconds of a two-question request at 8/16 threads over the confirmation requests

data_lat_fit_over.what: estimated two-question requests at 8/16 threads over the limit

data_lat_timeout.what: seconds the openQA hook waits for the decision

data_lat_four_max.what: slowest timed four-question request at 8/16 threads

data_lat_burst_over.what: requests sent in bursts of two or four that went over the limit

data_think_share.what: share of the generated tokens that is thinking, 17-job replay

data_think_median_on.what: median seconds per job, thinking on

data_think_median_off.what: median seconds per job, thinking off

data_think_time_saved.what: less total time with thinking off

data_readers_window_days.what: days over which the jobs with an LLM comment were counted

data_readers_jobs.what: jobs with an LLM comment in 42 days in the four job groups shown

data_readers_reviewed.what: of those, jobs a person later reviewed (bug reference or label)

data_readers_reviewed_share.what: share of the commented jobs a person reviewed

data_readers_development_jobs.what: commented jobs in the Development Tumbleweed group

data_readers_development_share.what: share of the commented jobs in the Development Tumbleweed group

data_readers_development_reviewed.what: commented Development Tumbleweed jobs a person reviewed

data_prs_open.what: pull requests still open on 14 November 2026, of the 28 opened

data_prs_open_first.what: first day an open pull request was opened

data_prs_open_last.what: last day an open pull request was opened

data_prs_read.what: day the pull request lists were read
